steps.code:
# Get sent transactions for this month (May 2023) using pagination.
access_token = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ2ZW5tbytjb2Quc21pdGhAZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyMDk4fQ.24BYyyAR6ISG_BiF5q6ChKvGB3PN36SjyKJt-btoAgk"
page = 0
all_transactions = []
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        page_index=page,
        page_limit=20
    )
    # Check if response is a list
    if isinstance(resp, list):
        all_transactions.extend(resp)
        if len(resp) < 20:
            break
        page += 1
    else:
        print("Error:", resp)
        break
print("Number of transactions:", len(all_transactions))
print(all_transactions)
